decisions.checklist: Actual 248 cards, 48 rookie-subset cards; advertised 250. All 20 TCDB insert families represented.
decisions.parallel: Base and shared insert parallel lists reconstructed using MyCardBatch shared checklists and sampled catalog identities; TCDB full parallel pages unavailable. Verify individual membership, prefixes and team data before release.
decisions.autographs: Gold 19 exact TCDB entries and serial runs, not 22-card mirror. Platinum and Masterpiece use source-specific 22-card lists; AU prefixes inferred.
decisions.team: Corrected apparent Aaron Brooks Green Bay source error to New Orleans; Randy Moss Minnesota variant retained from source pending scan review.
decisions.odds: Three uniform hobby insert odds populated. Combined memorabilia 1:12 and autographs 1:384 documented only; do not assign combined odds per family. Gold/rookie and retail collation pending.
